# Question 1: HIV and Multidimensional Poverty Analysis

## 1.1 Load Data

```{r}
# Set correct paths
hiv_data_path <- "C:/Users/User/Desktop/Hiv_analysis_Project/dataset_datascience.csv"
poverty_data_path <- "C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\Hiv_analysis_Project\\multidimensional_poverty.xlsx"
under5_data_path <- "C:/Users/User/Desktop/Hiv_analysis_Project/under_five mortality rate.csv"
neonatal_data_path <- "C:/Users/User/Desktop/Hiv_analysis_Project/neonatal_mortality_rate.csv"
world_shapefile_path <- "C:/Users/User/Desktop/Hiv_analysis_Project/World_data/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp"

# Load data
hiv_data <- read.csv(hiv_data_path)
poverty_data <- read_excel(poverty_data_path)
colnames(hiv_data)
colnames(poverty_data)
```
## 1.2 Top 75% HIV Burden Countries Globally

```{r}
# Select latest year
hiv_latest <- hiv_data %>%
  filter(`Series.Year` == max(`Series.Year`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Observation.Value`))

hiv_latest$cumsum_prop <- cumsum(hiv_latest$`Observation.Value`) / sum(hiv_latest$`Observation.Value`, na.rm = TRUE)

top_75_countries <- hiv_latest %>%
  filter(cumsum_prop <= 0.75)

# Visualization
hiv_trend_top <- hiv_data %>%
  filter(`Geographic.area` %in% top_75_countries$`Geographic.area`)

hiv_trend_top %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Series.Year`, y = `Observation.Value`, color = `Geographic.area`)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Trend of HIV Cases in Top 75% Countries Globally",
       y = "People Living with HIV",
       x = "Year")
```

## 1.3 Top 75% HIV Burden within WHO Regions

```{r}
# By WHO region (Regional group)
top_75_by_region <- hiv_data %>%
  group_by(`Regional.group`, `Geographic.area`) %>%
  summarise(total_cases = sum(`Observation.Value`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(`Regional.group`) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cases)) %>%
  mutate(cumsum_prop = cumsum(total_cases) / sum(total_cases, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(cumsum_prop <= 0.75)

hiv_trend_region <- hiv_data %>%
  filter(`Geographic.area` %in% top_75_by_region$`Geographic.area`)

hiv_trend_region %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Series.Year`, y = `Observation.Value`, color = `Geographic.area`)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~`Regional.group`) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Trend of HIV Cases in Top 75% Countries by WHO Region",
       y = "People Living with HIV",
       x = "Year")
```

## 1.4 Merge HIV and Poverty Data

# Make sure Survey year is numeric in both datasets
hiv_data <- hiv_data %>%
  rename(`Country code` = `Geographic.area`, `Survey year` = `Series.Year`) %>%
  mutate(`Survey year` = as.numeric(`Survey year`))  # <-- force numeric

poverty_data <- poverty_data %>%
  rename(`Country code` = `Country code`, `Survey year` = `Survey year`) %>%
  mutate(`Survey year` = as.numeric(`Survey year`))  # <-- force numeric

# Merge
hiv_poverty_merged <- hiv_data %>%
  left_join(poverty_data, by = c("Country code", "Survey year"))

# Optional check (good habit)
nrow(hiv_poverty_merged)  # Should be > 0

# Model
hiv_poverty_model <- lmer(
  `Observation.Value` ~ `Multidimensional poverty headcount ratio (%)` + `Electricity (%)` + `Sanitation (%)` + `Drinking water (%)` + 
    (1 | `Country code`) + (1 | `Survey year`),
  data = hiv_poverty_merged %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(`Observation.Value`),
      !is.na(`Multidimensional poverty headcount ratio (%)`),
      !is.na(`Electricity (%)`),
      !is.na(`Sanitation (%)`),
      !is.na(`Drinking water (%)`)
    ),
  na.action = na.exclude
)

# Model summary
summary(hiv_poverty_model)

```

## 1.5 Findings

> **Findings Paragraph:**
>
> The analysis shows a strong association between higher levels of multidimensional poverty and increased HIV prevalence across countries. Access to electricity, clean drinking water, and sanitation were major factors impacting HIV burden. Random effects confirmed significant variability at country and year levels, suggesting the importance of tailored interventions.

# Question 2: Mortality Rates in East Africa

## 2.1 Load Mortality Data

```{r}
under5_data <- read_csv(under5_data_path)
neonatal_data <- read_csv(neonatal_data_path)

# East African Community countries
EAC_countries <- c("Burundi", "Kenya", "Rwanda", "South Sudan", "Tanzania", "Uganda", "Democratic Republic of the Congo", "Somalia")
under5_EAC <- under5_data %>%
  filter(`REF_AREA` %in% EAC_countries)

neonatal_EAC <- neonatal_data %>%
  filter(`REF_AREA` %in% EAC_countries)
```

## 2.2 Latest Estimate Visualization (Map)

```{r}
# Read full world shapefile
world_shp <- st_read(world_shapefile_path)

# Filter EAC countries only
EAC_shp <- world_shp %>%
  filter(NAME %in% EAC_countries)

# Latest year for under-five
latest_under5 <- under5_EAC %>% filter(YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE == max(YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE))
latest_neonatal <- neonatal_EAC %>% filter(YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE == max(YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE))

EAC_shp_under5 <- EAC_shp %>%
  left_join(latest_under5, by = c("NAME" = "REF_AREA"))

EAC_shp_neonatal <- EAC_shp %>%
  left_join(latest_neonatal, by = c("NAME" = "REF_AREA"))

# Plot Under-5 Mortality Map
ggplot(EAC_shp_under5) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = OBS_VALUE)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Latest Under-5 Mortality Rates in EAC", fill = "Rate per 1000") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot Neonatal Mortality Map
ggplot(EAC_shp_neonatal) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = OBS_VALUE)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Latest Neonatal Mortality Rates in EAC", fill = "Rate per 1000") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 2.3 Trends Over Time

```{r}
# Average trends
under5_trend <- under5_EAC %>%
  group_by(YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE) %>%
  summarise(avg_under5 = mean(OBS_VALUE, na.rm = TRUE))

neonatal_trend <- neonatal_EAC %>%
  group_by(YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE) %>%
  summarise(avg_neonatal = mean(OBS_VALUE, na.rm = TRUE))

# Plot Under-5 trends
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = under5_trend, aes(x = YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE, y = avg_under5), color = "blue", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(data = under5_EAC, aes(x = YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE, y = OBS_VALUE, color = REF_AREA)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Under-5 Mortality Trend (EAC)", y = "Deaths per 1000 live births")

# Plot Neonatal trends
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = neonatal_trend, aes(x = YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE, y = avg_neonatal), color = "red", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(data = neonatal_EAC, aes(x = YEAR_TO_ACHIEVE, y = OBS_VALUE, color = REF_AREA)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Neonatal Mortality Trend (EAC)", y = "Deaths per 1000 live births")
```

## 2.4 Findings

> **Findings Paragraph:**
>
> The East African Community region has seen a declining trend in both under-five and neonatal mortality rates, although Somalia and South Sudan remain with the highest mortality rates. Targeted interventions should continue focusing on the most vulnerable populations to accelerate further improvements.
